Exhaustive Round 1 screening across the local research catalog, Europe PMC, live 2026 PubMed/ClinicalTrials.gov sweeps, and Oracle/external cultural lookups found no qualifying controlled clinical or preclinical signal transferring to refined grapeseed oil and Parkinson anxiety severity. No matching traditional or public forum efficacy account was identified. The parent review mentions grape seed oil and other grape forms. The cited original tests grape seed oil in a scopolamine rat study. Spatial memory and acetylcholine are distinct outcomes from clinical anxiety. Refining status and Parkinson anxiety are unresolved.
